🔥 The fire settles. the man in his 30s, with a scarred cheek has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "Something huge, rooting in the underbrush — I put it down today." "Lowers its head, paws the earth. Dust rises. It is not going around the tree. It has never gone around anything." "It stops. Blood on its snout, sides heaving. It has decided you are not worth dying for — it backs away, quills flat." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Petra says quietly "Did it look at you? Before?" ◈ SYSTEM: "Four waves. FOUR. The producers are — okay, I'm saying it: FINALES need a NATION. You've got a region; now make it a REALM. Bind fires under one head, or bend the knee to someone who has. The higher-ups are watching. ...Did I say higher-ups? I said NOTHING. Forget the higher-ups."

◈ ARC IV — THE INEFFICIENCY. SYSTEM: "ROUNDING ERROR RECLASSIFIED: ANOMALY. Organic consumption yields impossible output. Recalculating. Recalculating." — They finally see it. The thing they laughed at — needing to EAT — is the engine. Their confusion is your weapon now. You stood up to the calibration fauna, the audience's notes, the Final Draft — lived through their Show, weathered the worst together, and built something bigger than a village. 📺 "You've gotten too big for the story. Ratings are GREAT, by the way — but you're threatening the narrative now. So the narrative is fighting back. Meet the PRODUCERS."

📻 The producers name it: the Nielsen. Ratings embodied. It fights boring — and the crowd adores it for that.
